control.title: Protection of stored account data
control.description: Keep stored card data to a minimum with a retention limit, never store sensitive authentication data after authorisation, mask PAN when displayed and render it unreadable wherever stored (tokenisation, truncation or strong encryption).

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Data retention settings, PAN masking screenshot, tokenisation or encryption configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Card numbers are masked when displayed
Stored card numbers are tokenised, truncated or strongly encrypted
Sensitive authentication data is not stored after authorisation

requirements.title: PCI DSS, encryption and fraud prevention
requirements.guidance: Systems that detect and prevent fraud and protect customers; PCI DSS (and PA-DSS) compliance with current encryption standards.

requirements.title: Data security, PCI DSS and half-yearly restore tests
requirements.guidance: Data leak prevention, an ISMS, encryption in transit and at rest, PCI DSS for stored card data, and backup restore tests at least half-yearly.

requirements.title: No card credentials stored by merchants
requirements.guidance: Card credentials must not be stored in databases or servers that merchants can access; use tokenisation.
